messages:
Zara: quick design note — compact compare toolbar feels cramped. sketched a variant that moves pin to left column and adds a density toggle. figma: https://figma.com/s/compact-compare (WIP).
Kevin: nice. main win?
Zara: reduces layout shift when toggling pins, makes keyboard targets consistent. density toggle: Compact / Comfortable. Compact hides sparklines, Comfortable shows them.
Jeff: a11y callout: don't rely on hover for necessary info. if sparklines are hidden, provide aria-describedby text like "Latency p50 120ms, trend stable". Also pinned state must be announced on load.
Kevin: color/contrast quick check: if badges go from 11px -> 13px in Comfortable mode that helps legibility. prefer darker fills with white text.
Zara: will update figma with two sizes and add ARIA examples. tagging @jeff for quick pass.
aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: ensure badge contrast >= 4.5:1 and keyboard order: pin -> compare -> name -> badges -> actions.
